use_case_summary: Primary objective: deploy Redwood Private in a customer-managed VPC to power clinical-document search and a patient-facing triage assistant. Must maintain PHI on US-resident infrastructure, integrate with their IdP for SSO (SAML) + SCIM provisioning, and enforce RBAC from Redwood console for least-privilege access. Also need audit logs shipped to Splunk and KMS integration with on-prem HSM for key material.
notes: InfoSec: HIPAA + HITRUST baseline, prefer HSM-backed keys; will accept KMS proxy pattern but want paper trail.
Quote from CISO: 'We cannot accept any unmanaged key material outside our HSM — need an auditable key flow.'
IdP: Okta w/ SCIM provisioning; current SCIM groups map to AD groups. They want group->role mapping: developers, ML-ops, auditors, read-only analysts.
RBAC ask: need ability to restrict model rollout controls to ML-ops and prevent devs from changing routing policies. Console must show effective permissions per token/account.
Audit logging: must forward request-level logs + model invocation metadata to Splunk and keep 2 years of retention; also need exportable audit trail for compliance reviews.
Data residency: production Private VPC must be US-only (no multi-region replication outside US). Staging can be in us-west-2 only; on-prem connector evaluated for sensitive workloads.
POC plan: 2-week Private deployment in staging VPC -> run 1M token/day load test, validate SAML SSO flow, SCIM provisioning sync, RBAC enforcement, key rotation tests against HSM simulator.
Technical concerns noted: model weights storage encryption at rest + transit, KMS endpoints and networking egress rules, operator access to control plane, backup snapshots retention policy.
Commercial: looking at 12–36 month reserved capacity after successful POC. Budget range preliminary $400k-$1M ARR. Procurement expects SOW + security addendum.
Next: schedule SCIM attribute mapping workshop with Okta admin + Marco + Redwood engineering (target week of 2026-03-07).
